bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; establishing a consolidated list of people and vendors who may not receive state contracts or payments; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 16A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[16A.092] DO NOT PAY DATABASE.

Subdivision 1.

Do not pay database.

The commissioner, with assistance from the commissioner of information technology services, must maintain a database of individuals or businesses who are prohibited from receiving state money. The commissioner must add a person to the database when the person passes away, is convicted of or suspected of fraud against the state, or owes money to the state.

Subd. 2.

Contributions from all agencies.

All state agencies must provide names and data to the commissioner for addition to the database when the agency determines that a person has passed away, is convicted of or suspected of fraud against the state, or owes money to the state.

Subd. 3.

Confirmation of status before action.

The commissioner must make the database available to agencies. Before entering a contract or making a payment, an agency must check the name of a vendor or payment recipient against the database to ensure the person or business is eligible to contract or receive a payment.

All state agencies must provide names and data to the commissioner for addition to the database when the agency determines that a person has passed away, is convicted of or suspected of fraud against the state, or owes money to the state.

The commissioner must make the database available to agencies. Before entering a contract or making a payment, an agency must check the name of a vendor or payment recipient against the database to ensure the person or business is eligible to contract or receive a payment.
